super_skills.name: Secured Exit Approach Review
super_skills.rationale: Combines sustained approach, direction and optional Access context without identity or intent claims.

super_skills.name: Room Exit Sequence Review
super_skills.rationale: Correlates anonymous room-zone progression and defaults to review-only, skeleton-compatible evidence.

super_skills.name: Mobility-Aid Egress Obstruction Review
super_skills.rationale: Uses required customer-supplied mobility-aid weights and fails silently when unavailable.

super_skills.name: Controlled-Room Person-Count Review
super_skills.rationale: Correlates Access grants with observed anonymous doorway crossings and presence counts.

super_skills.name: Care-Area Occupancy Imbalance
super_skills.rationale: Compares sustained anonymous occupancy between configured care zones without asserting staffing adequacy.

super_skills.name: Waiting-Room Flow Ledger
super_skills.rationale: Measures anonymous arrival, waiting, service and exit transitions with bounded wait and abandonment summaries.

super_skills.name: Vision Estate Health
super_skills.rationale: Consolidates camera, stream, image, event-reference and detector-readiness signals into maintenance priorities.

super_skills.name: Perimeter Event Verifier
super_skills.rationale: Correlates controller events with object class, boundary direction, dwell and schedule before review escalation.

super_skills.name: Multi-Zone Intrusion Progression Review
super_skills.rationale: Records anonymous perimeter-to-yard-to-doorway progression without biometric re-identification or intent claims.

super_skills.name: Package-Room Chain Review
super_skills.rationale: Links Access context and package-count changes using mandatory domain weights and bounded chain state.

super_skills.name: After-Hours Multi-Camera Corroboration
super_skills.rationale: Escalates only when distinct cameras observe compatible anonymous classes within a bounded window.

super_skills.name: Door Alarm Observed Response Timer
super_skills.rationale: Measures controller alarm-to-observed-arrival and close timing without identifying responders or asserting resolution.

super_skills.name: Anonymous Zone Funnel
super_skills.rationale: Aggregates ephemeral entrance-to-checkout progression, dwell and drop-off without identity or cross-visit recognition.

super_skills.name: Queue Service Rate Digest
super_skills.rationale: Combines arrival rate, wait percentiles, service throughput, abandonment and backlog trend.

super_skills.name: Curbside Handoff Timer
super_skills.rationale: Measures arrival, first approach, handoff-zone overlap and departure rather than stopping at arrival.

super_skills.name: Drive-Thru Lane Balance
super_skills.rationale: Compares queue depth, dwell and throughput across two configured lanes.

super_skills.name: Table Reset Delay Review
super_skills.rationale: Uses vacancy, service approach and bounded scene change to report reset-cycle delays without employee scoring.

super_skills.name: High-Traffic Service Trigger
super_skills.rationale: Creates inspection or replenishment triggers from anonymous traffic counts without claiming cleanliness or completion.

super_skills.name: Dock Stage Turnaround
super_skills.rationale: Measures vehicle progression through arrival, staging, dock and departure with per-stage dwell.

super_skills.name: Dock Apron Conflict Review
super_skills.rationale: Uses calibrated person/vehicle trajectory convergence and separation as review evidence, not a near-miss determination.

super_skills.name: Forklift Route Deviation Review
super_skills.rationale: Requires forklift weights and compares tracks with configured corridors and direction rules.

super_skills.name: Aisle Blockage Duration Review
super_skills.rationale: Reports persistent object overlap and duration in aisle and emergency-access zones.

super_skills.name: Cycle Step Timer
super_skills.rationale: Measures per-track configured workcell stage timing and skipped or overlong observed steps.

super_skills.name: Yard Queue Bottleneck Digest
super_skills.rationale: Combines arrival, queue growth, staging dwell, dock release and spillback into one digest.

super_skills.name: Multi-Class Flow Ledger
super_skills.rationale: Produces scheduled directional counts by supported object class with bounded summaries.

super_skills.name: Anonymous Space Utilization Percentiles
super_skills.rationale: Reports bounded occupancy, dwell, turnover and utilization percentiles without visitor identity.

super_skills.name: Route Completion Ledger
super_skills.rationale: Measures anonymous same-session checkpoint progression and completion without identifying the person.

super_skills.name: Zone Activity Schedule Baseline
super_skills.rationale: Learns time-of-week count and motion ranges and reports sustained observed deviations after training.

super_skills.name: Shift Change Flow Review
super_skills.rationale: Summarizes congestion, direction, queueing and person/vehicle overlap during configured shift windows.

super_skills.name: Exception Evidence Casebook
super_skills.rationale: Creates bounded local incident records linking controller events, observed counts, checksums and review context.

hanwha-factory.title: Hanwha Vision factory and safety analytics

guardrails: No face recognition, biometric identity, emotion inference, or cross-visit identity.
Outputs describe observed evidence for human review; they are not legal, clinical, life-safety, or intent determinations.
Domain-model workflows fail silently when required weights are missing or unreadable.
Resident-room workflows remain compatible with skeleton privacy mode and snapshot suppression.
No super skill controls a door, vehicle, production machine, or life-safety system.
